notes: This adapter-backed public C++ TCK scenario exercises object discovery through the official RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs while a transparent loopback observer checks the IEEE 1516.1-2025 federate-protocol frame direction. It requires at least one HLA_CALL_RESPONSE and one HLA_CALLBACK_REQUEST and verifies that every observed frame of either type travels from RTI to federate, directly witnessing §12.13.4.6 page 408 lines 113-114. Evidence is bounded to the tested provider and this object-discovery service path; it does not establish direction for unobserved message types, independent-provider interoperability, or complete conformance.

api_surfaces.signature: The public object-discovery TCK case runs through a process-backed C++ provider; an external loopback observer verifies that observed HLA_CALL_RESPONSE and HLA_CALLBACK_REQUEST frames are sent by the RTI
